verdict.rationale: Motion's docs say recurring tasks (daily, weekly, monthly or quarterly) get time blocked on the calendar automatically. They also say the AI reshuffles the whole day or week when meetings run long or emergencies arise, and that daily meeting limits make the calendar unbookable. Together these imply recurring work blocks are protected and rescheduled rather than lost. missing for 10: an explicit focus-time or habit-defense feature, documentation that recurring blocks are moved rather than dropped when conflicts appear, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
